cancel.title: Payment Cancelled
cancel.alertText: You cancelled the payment, so your registration was not created. You can try again anytime.

fail.title: Payment Failed
fail.alertText: We could not complete your payment. {error} Your registration was not created — please try again and stay on this browser until you see the payment successful message.

success.title: Payment Successful
success.robofestConfirmed: Your payment is completed and your registration for RoboFest Bangladesh 2026 is officially confirmed.
success.robofestEmailSent: A confirmation email has been sent to all team members with your team details, along with a PDF of your registration.
success.robofestSafeToLeave: You can safely leave this page once you have noted your Registration ID below.
success.eventConfirmed: Your payment is completed and your event registration is now confirmed. A confirmation email has been sent to your email address with all details.
success.emailNotSentText: We could not send the confirmation email automatically. Your registration and payment are still valid.
success.checkSpam: Please check spam/junk folders, or contact support with your Registration ID so we can resend the confirmation.

researchHub.confirmed: Your payment is complete and your Research Hub slot is confirmed. A confirmation email with your pass has been sent.
researchHub.confirmedNoEmail: Your payment is complete and your Research Hub slot is confirmed. We could not send the confirmation email, so please save your booking code below.
researchHub.codeLabel: Your booking code — show this at the front desk
researchHub.cancelled: You cancelled the payment, so no seats were booked and you were not charged.
researchHub.slotTaken: Your seat hold expired and someone else booked the last seats before payment finished. You were not charged. Please pick another time.
researchHub.refunded: We could not confirm your seats, so your payment has been refunded to your bKash account. Details: {error}
researchHub.paymentFailed: The payment did not go through, so no seats were booked. {error}
